subject.title: Resume chat after reconnect via sequence cursor (gateway + mobile clients)

question: Should this workstream proceed with the existing `chat.history.inFlightRun` snapshot contract instead of adding a new `chat.history.afterSeq` cursor, and how should Android be tracked after the cursor branch was closed?
rationale: The original proposed Gateway protocol surface was closed as superseded, while the remaining open PR covers only Apple recovery and the protected labels require a maintainer-owned cross-platform direction.

options.title: Use Snapshot Contract
options.body: Continue through the open Apple snapshot PR, then track Android as a separate snapshot-based follow-up with live reconnect proof.

options.title: Reopen Cursor Design
options.body: Revive an additive `afterSeq` contract only after maintainers explicitly accept the protocol surface and bounded pagination semantics.

options.title: Split Platform Trackers
options.body: Retitle or split this issue so Apple, Android, and Gateway protocol work each have separate acceptance and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Use Snapshot Contract
recommendation.body: Continue through the open Apple snapshot PR, then track Android as a separate snapshot-based follow-up with live reconnect proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this issue and authored the superseding PR/comments that changed the workstream direction.
